# Pixel Palette Generator

A simple offline browser app that generates harmonious 5‑color palettes. Each swatch shows its hex code and has a lock toggle to keep that color when generating a new palette.

## Features

- 5 color swatches with hex codes
- Generate button for a new harmonious palette
- Lock toggle on each swatch to preserve colors
- Keyboard accessible (buttons are focusable and labeled)
- Responsive layout down to 360px wide
- Uses only HTML, CSS, and plain JavaScript

## Usage

Open `index.html` in any modern browser. Click **Generate New Palette** to create a new set of colors. Click the lock icon on any swatch to lock that color; locked colors remain unchanged when generating a new palette.

## Files

- `index.html` – main page structure
- `styles.css` – styling and responsive layout
- `app.js` – palette generation and lock logic

No external dependencies or network requests are used.
